name: pstack
description: A port of Lauren Tan's pstack skills to Claude Code. /bro restates your last message in plain language, /unslop strips AI tells from prose, and /no-comments sends the Comment Sicko agent through a diff to delete comments and flag the code that made them necessary. Ships the dependency cone those three pull in: architect, arena, how, why, interrogate, show-me-your-work and 14 principle skills, all rewired to the Agent tool and Claude Code model pools.
